requirements.title: createNewDeck does not bake title sizes
requirements.description: createNewDeck() must not set titleFontSize or subTitleFontSize on the seeded first TITLE slide (match addSlide(TITLE)).

requirements.title: New deck Font size updates first title
requirements.description: After creating a new deck, changing deck Font size updates that first title and subtitle in Present and the editor program thumbnail.

requirements.title: Added TITLE and non-title still inherit
requirements.description: Newly added TITLE slides and non-title slides continue to inherit GENERAL font size as they do today.

requirements.title: Preserve existing baked sizes
requirements.description: Opening or editing a deck that already has baked titleFontSize / subTitleFontSize leaves those values unchanged.

requirements.title: Release notes bullet
requirements.description: Release notes for the shipping version mention this fix in user-facing language.

todos.content: In createNewDeck(), do not set titleFontSize or subTitleFontSize on the seeded first TITLE slide (match addSlide(TITLE) inheritance from GENERAL).
After creating a new deck, changing deck Font size updates the first title and subtitle in Present overlay and the editor program thumbnail.
Decks that already have baked titleFontSize / subTitleFontSize keep those values; do not strip on open or rewrite on Font size change.
Add or extend an automated check (Jack’s precedence cases or equivalent unit test) that fails if createNewDeck again bakes sizes that override GENERAL fontSize.
Include a user-facing release-notes bullet for this fix on the PR (new decks’ first title now follows Font size; older decks with fixed title sizes unchanged).

acceptanceCriteria: After createNewDeck, the first TITLE slide has no titleFontSize or subTitleFontSize.
After createNewDeck + GENERAL fontSize change, Present overlay title/subtitle use the GENERAL fontSize.
addSlide(TITLE) without baked sizes still follows GENERAL fontSize.
Non-title slides still follow GENERAL fontSize.
A slide with pre-existing baked titleFontSize / subTitleFontSize keeps those values after GENERAL fontSize change.
Automated precedence check is in CI (Jest) and fails if createNewDeck bakes sizes again.
PR body includes a user-facing release-notes bullet.
Do not merge; Jack is merge gate.

selected.reason: Root cause: createNewDeck bakes 48px/28px which override GENERAL via titleFontSize ?? style.fontSize. Unblocks REQ-002 verification and the precedence regression test.
